name: Sniper Butterfly
description: A captivating romance unfolds between a confident, cat-like woman and a bold, loyal younger man. As they navigate their differences, they find mutual healing and redemption, leading to a passionate, fate-driven love story full of tension and desire.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: When their paths cross at work, Cen Jin sees past Li Wu's aloof demeanor and recognizes him as the teen whose education her family once helped support.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: After their unorthodox first meeting, Jin pays off Wu's family and brings him to the city so he can repeat his final year of school.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Amid a fraught new project, Jin tries to distance herself from Wu in the workplace — but her reticence only draws him closer.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: A health scare lands a young Wu in the hospital, prompting Jin to learn his quirks and boundaries as they adjust to living under one roof.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Back in the present, Wu pays a surprise visit to Jin's apartment late at night — and makes a drunken confession.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: In 2016, Jin confides in her parents that she's planning to leave her husband, Wu Fu. Meanwhile, Wu bonds with his school roommate Cheng Rui.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Wu rushes to visit his aunt after getting a worrying call about her health, but Jin insists on accompanying him to the remote village.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Rui teaches Wu how to use social media, but his first post causes Jin to worry that peer pressure may be clouding his studies.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: When Wu takes the fall for a friend's poor behavior at school, Jin intervenes to smooth things over with his professors — and his angry aunt and uncle.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Wu stands up to a group of bullies who mock his humble background. In 2024, Jin goes on a dinner date with Lu Weiyan.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Juggling a complicated pitch at work, Jin clashes with her colleague Li Fei. Wu helps her find creative inspiration.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: At an archery range, a jealous Wu uses small ploys to monopolize Jin's attention and keep her from getting too close to Weiyan.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Concerned that Wu lives right across the hall from Jin, Weiyan probes her about their complicated relationship.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Chun Chang flirts with Shen Yiyang, who promises to help her with the bar. Wu pushes his team to hit an important deadline.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: As Wu prepares to take his final college entrance exam, a sentimental gift from Jin steadies his nerves. In the present, Wu struggles to sleep.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: When Jin's mother invites Weiyan over for dinner, Wu volunteers to help cook the meal. At the bar, Yiyang steps in to help Chang.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Despite receiving offers from several prestigious universities, Wu decides he'd rather attend a school nearby — and stay as close to Jin as possible.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: In Wu's room, Jin stumbles upon a photo of herself hidden among his school supplies and begins to question their entire relationship.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: In 2018, a leg injury forces Jin to rely on Wu for everyday tasks around the home, leaving her reevaluating their situation.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Encouraged by their deepening friendship following Jin's injury, Wu rushes to surprise her after work and makes a bold move.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: A model pulls out of Jin's commercial shoot at the last minute, forcing her to quickly find a replacement. Luckily, Wu is eager to lend a hand.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Fearing that their new bond is holding Wu back from pursuing an international exchange program, Jin secretly plans a bold career move to protect him.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: When Wu discovers her deception, Jin must choose between her own happiness and his future success — even if it means losing him forever.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: After six long years of pining over lost love, Wu and Jin openly reconcile their true feelings and begin a new chapter in their relationship.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Wu gives a presentation at a major conference. Jin receives an invitation to a colleague's wedding — and worries she'll run into her ex-husband.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: After seeing photos from the wedding, Jin's mother drops by for a surprise visit and confirms her suspicion that Wu is interested in her daughter.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Shifting into crisis mode, Wu and Rui desperately seek alternative funding as investors begin to pull out of their project.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Rui and Wu collaborate on a pitch that could save their struggling company. Meanwhile, Chang organizes a romantic date with Yiyang.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Jin's parents debate whether Wu is a good match for their daughter. Chang and Yiyang work through their own family tensions.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Yiyang asks an important question. After her family invites them to dinner as a couple, Jin and Wu look to their future together.
